actual_document_cross_reference.finding: The early canonical-panel cascade paragraph maps Table 6.8 to Table S29, which is the ADMIXTURE cross-validation error table, unrelated to that cascade.
actual_document_cross_reference.main_paragraph_text: [Observed] The cascade, defined once. Stage 10's panel held 44 canonical codon-allele records, covering 41 distinct protein changes, in eight of the nine panel genes (pfcoronin contributed none); 21 were polymorphic in these 1,900 isolates; 6 of the 21 survived the ingest mask — the in_genomewide_scan field, defined at step10_resistance_panel.py:349 as numalt == 1, i.e. "would have survived the ingest filter"; and 3 reached the MAF-filtered scan matrix: pfdhfr C59R, pfdhfr N51I and pfaat1 S258L. The other three that passed the mask — pfcrt I356T, pfmdr1 D1246Y and pfcrt N326S — were then cut by MAF ≥ 0.05 at frequencies of 0.016, 0.011 and 0.008. These four numbers (44, 21, 6, 3) carry exactly this meaning wherever they appear in this manuscript, and the Abstract, Table 1.1, Section 6.8.3, Table 6.8 and Section 10.1 use this wording. In particular, the genome-wide scan did test three of the 21 polymorphic canonical codons, and no pfcrt, pfmdr1, pfdhps or pfk13 codon reached the MAF-filtered scan matrix — pfdhps because nothing survived the ingest mask, the others because what survived was either too rare (pfcrt I356T, pfcrt N326S and pfmdr1 D1246Y all passed the mask, reached the genome-wide store and were then cut by MAF at 0.016, 0.011 and 0.008) or monomorphic here (six pfk13 codons — F446I, P441L, Y493H, P553L, R561H, A675V — passed the mask and were fetched and found invariant). "Could not test at all" would be true of the final MAF-filtered scan matrix but false of ascertainment, which is the distinction this paragraph exists to draw, so the stronger wording is not used.

actual_document_cross_reference.s29_caption_text: Table S29. ADMIXTURE 10-fold cross-validation error, K = 1-8 (logs/admixture_K*.out). Lower is better. K = 1 is not part of the supplied sweep and was added so the improvement from admitting structure at all could be measured. The total range across K = 1-8 is 0.00563, 0.67 per cent of the error value; the improvement from K = 1 to K = 2 is 0.00459, 0.54 per cent.
